label: Black Dragon
description: a fierce kung-fu master called the Black Dragon: long black hair tied in a high topknot with loose strands, a short black goatee, a sleeveless black kung-fu jacket with gold frog buttons and a coiling gold dragon embroidered on it, a red sash belt, loose black trousers, black kung-fu shoes, black leather wrist guards
portrait: a cold, confident stare, one hand formed into a dragon claw beside the face with wisps of black smoke and a gold glow
portrait_bg: dark charcoal with a faint gold glow

moves.block: both forearms raised with hands in dragon claws
moves.light: A fast clawed-hand swipe toward the LEFT at face height.
moves.light_hit: the dragon claw raking forward to the LEFT at face height
moves.heavy: A spinning low sweep kick along the ground toward the LEFT, aimed at the shins.
moves.heavy_hit: the leg sweeping forward to the LEFT near the ground
moves.charge: Black smoke swirls around him in the shape of a coiling dragon, with a gold glow on his fists (black and gold only).
moves.special_fx: Black smoke and a gold glow follow the fists (black and gold only).
hits: a rushing dragon punch trailing black smoke
a rising uppercut with a gold glow
a double-palm strike releasing a large black-smoke dragon head with gold eyes
